title: Basement / pass 01 and native evidence
summary: New corridor models are delivered and independently reviewed: 25 meshes, 25 FBXs, one atlas and native Unreal checks. Models / Model review contain the result; Agent production explains the delegated session and prepared automation. Original concepts and Pass 01 remain available.

items.title: New / 25 corridor models delivered and verified
items.alt: Native Blender assembly of the delivered corridor asset families
items.body:
**Models/export set verified by the orchestrator. Owner aesthetic review pending.** The requested OpenCode worker used DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017 / OpenCode Go / max. All N01–N07 families are delivered inside the required existing blends, with 25 FBXs and one graphic atlas. Open **Models** for real model previews, **Model review** for downloads/paths/checks and **Agent production** for the repeatable delegation/automation workflow. No final Basement placement or LaCarlota save was made.

items.title: 02 / Shop: first service-area pass implemented
items.body:
**Implemented and agent-verified, 12 November 2026.** A restrained equipment sign, a reused fluorescent fixture and one warm local rectangular light establish the service counter. The existing barred delivery opening remains the fantasy accent.

The owner explained that the NPC serves through the open window and releases equipment through the separate bars/spikes. NPC choice and interaction behavior remain deferred.

The **Pass 01** subtab has the matching before image, camera provenance and exact changed files. Owner aesthetic acceptance is pending.
